tier: AWS Free plan, t4g.small free trial

free_tier.stated: Quoted from the t4g page: 'Free Trial: Try Amazon EC2 t4g.small instances powered by AWS Graviton2 processors free for up to 750 hours / month until Dec 31st 2026.' notes: The most consequential correction makes. The corpus records AWS as a card-gated trial (`microsoft-azure-free-account` style, and `amazon-web-services-free-tier` as a card trial), and that is out of date: AWS's new signup states that most new customers are not asked for a payment method, and the Free plan carries a 750-hour-a-month t4g.small allowance on top of the credits. Four caveats, and the first is the important one. (1) 'Most' is not 'all': the page says a payment method may be requested for additional verification, and when it is, USD 1 is held for 3 to 5 days. That is a real possibility, not a certainty, so the row is caveated rather than clean. (2) The Free plan closes the account at six months or when the credits run out, and the credits are spendable on anything, so an expensive shape burns the plan early and a cheap one does not extend it. (3) The t4g.small trial is advertised until 2026-12-31, which is about two months from this reading, so a person starting now gets the shorter of six months and that date. (4) The 750 hours are per month, so a single instance at 24/7 uses the whole allowance and a second instance is billed. Egress for this shape is not published on any page read. This record does not supersede `amazon-web-services-free-tier`, which prices the credit offer; it adds the no-card signup path and the specific free instance shapes, which the corpus did not have.
